info.title: TWAM E-Commerce API
info.description:
FastAPI backend — TWAM E-Commerce Platform.

## Authentication
All protected endpoints require a Bearer JWT token.

### How to get a token:
1. `POST /connect/token` with form: `grant_type=password`, `username`, `password`,
   `client_id`, `client_secret` (values stored in AppSettings)
2. Copy `access_token` from response
3. Click **Authorize** above → paste the token

### Roles:
| ID | Name | Access |
|----|------|--------|
| 1 | Super Admin | Full access |
| 2 | User | Customer-facing endpoints |
| 3 | Inventory Manager | Products, stock |
| 4 | Product Manager | Products, categories |
| 5 | Order Manager | Orders, shipments |
| 6 | Customer Support | Orders, reviews, support |

The UserId column is the only link to the customer.
Admin can paste in user IDs from the segment-generated Excel or any other source.

post.description:
Accepts the admin-filled Excel (based on the template above).
Required columns: UserId, CouponCode, CouponName, Discount.
Optional: Description, StartDate, EndDate.

Each row becomes one user-specific coupon.
All rows in a single upload share the same batchId for audit/rollback.

NOTE: If rows have different coupon codes / discounts, each unique combination
is treated as a sub-group. In practice, admins usually keep the same
coupon settings for everyone in a single upload.

Admin picks a segment + coupon details → coupons are assigned to all
matching users in one go. No Excel file needed.

Flow:
  1. Admin views segment preview (POST /UserSegments/Preview)
  2. Admin is satisfied with the list
  3. Admin calls this endpoint with segment + coupon details
  4. All matched users receive a personal coupon

delete.description:
Hard-deletes the currently authenticated user's account.

What is DELETED (hard delete — gone permanently):
  • twam.People           — profile row
  • auth.IdentityUser     — login credentials (email/phone/password)
  • auth.OtpStore         — any OTPs
  • twam.Cart             — all cart items
  • twam.Wishlist         — all wishlist items
  • twam.Address          — all saved addresses
  • twam.Notification     — all notifications

What is KEPT (needed for business records):
  • twam.Orders           — order history (for fulfilment, invoices, returns)
  • twam.OrderItems       — order line items
  • twam.OrderRefund      — payment/refund logs

After deletion the user can register again with the same email/phone
and will get a completely fresh account with no previous data.

post.summary: Recalculate CGST/SGST on all PVDs for a product
post.description:
Re-computes CGST, SGST, and TaxAmount for every active PVD of this product
using the product's current TaxHSNCode and each PVD's FinalPrice.

Use this when:
- A TaxHSNCode was attached to an existing product that already had PVDs.
- The product's HSN code was changed and you want to force a re-sync.
- You need to confirm existing PVD tax values are up to date.

post.summary: Recalculate CGST/SGST across all products that have an HSN code
post.description:
Sweeps every product that has a TaxHSNCodeId set and re-computes CGST/SGST
on all its PVDs.  Useful for one-time data fixes or after a GST rate change.

This operation can be slow on large catalogs — it processes every PVD row.
Errors on individual PVDs are collected but do not abort the sweep.

post.description:

Register your warehouse pickup/return address with Ekart (POST /api/v2/address).

Call this ONCE after setting up ShipmentConfigurations. On success,
Ekart registers the address under the given alias. The alias is then
automatically saved to ShipmentConfigurations.PickupAlias so all future
shipments send {"name": alias} instead of the full address object —
resolving SWIFT_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND_EXCEPTION.

Use a meaningful alias like "TWAM-HYD-WH" (brand + city + warehouse).
